population.selection_rule: one disjoint exact-title pair surfaced before this freeze by the public related-market card and public Polymarket search

question: Can this exact public-title pair be rejected cheaply because neither predeclared opposite-side package is strictly below one pUSD before fees, or because its payout rules are not byte-equivalent?

browser_access.operation: logged-out public read-only rendering of the two exact URLs
allowed_observations: rendered Buy Yes and Buy No prices
visible top-of-book price and size when present
visible venue comparator probability when present

decision.rule_mismatch: reject immediately if the exact resolution source, deadline, agreement definition, exception, fallback, or invalid-market treatment differs
decision.price_rejection: reject if both visible opposite-side ask sums are at least 1.000 pUSD before fees or if any required ask is unavailable
decision.apparent_subfloor: record discovery only; do not accept or promote this pre-exposed population; require a disjoint prospectively frozen exact-rule and side-specific depth confirmation including all fees, transfer, capital, settlement, custody, failure, latency, and adverse-tick costs

retry_policy: The two exact top-level browser navigations are one-use for this contract. Preserve a block, missing field, or ambiguous render as rejection. Do not retry aliases, authenticated routes, APIs, accounts, or books for this population.
